comment: Per-component bundle size budgets for @helixui/library (gzipped bytes, measured from dist/). Override per-component with the overrides map. Changes require code review.

hx-date-picker.reason: Complex widget: calendar grid, date parsing, keyboard navigation, localization. Shared positioning logic is a candidate for extraction.

hx-color-picker.reason: Complex widget: gradient canvas, hue/opacity sliders, format conversion (hex/rgb/hsl), swatch management.

hx-combobox.reason: Complex widget: typeahead filtering, multi-select chip management, keyboard listbox navigation, async loading.

hx-select.reason: Complex widget: custom listbox rendering, keyboard navigation, form participation, grouped options.

hx-time-picker.reason: Complex widget: time parsing, 12/24h format, step intervals, keyboard-navigable listbox.

hx-tree-view.reason: Complex widget: recursive tree rendering, multi-select, keyboard arrow navigation, lazy loading.

hx-form.reason: Form orchestration: ElementInternals aggregation, cross-field validation, FormData construction.

hx-nav.reason: Complex widget: responsive breakpoints, nested submenus, keyboard navigation, mobile collapse.

hx-file-upload.reason: Complex widget: drag-and-drop, file validation, progress tracking, multi-file management.
